description: Turn automatic remeshing of zones on or off. With it on, the mesh is rebuilt during cycling when zone shape quality falls too low. Configure it with zone remesh.

notes: FLAC2D only: FLAC3D rejects it. The manual page is empty; this entry comes from running it.
Cycling needs model large-strain on and a boundary from zone remesh boundary; without them the first step fails.
The zone count changes during cycling: a 36-zone compression model went to 20 zones and ran twice as far before geometry failed.
The engine calls remeshing a beta feature.
